Sources are Novo Nordisk's Annual Report 2024 and Remuneration Report 2024 (PDFs on novonordisk.com); the Form 20-F 2024 (company copy) was also read and cross-refers to them. DKK, converted exactly from DKK million. LEADER: Lars Fruergaard Jørgensen was President and CEO throughout FY2024 (relation 'former-ceo' follows the site's current role label). He held 590,550 B shares at 31 December 2024; no percentage is given (for reference only, about 0.013% of the 4,465 million A and B shares; not disclosed). The 20-F says board and executive members together held 1,534,378 B shares, 'less than 1% of the beneficial ownership'. HOLDER: Novo Holdings A/S's 28.05% is of total share capital (A plus B), so it is economic; its 77.28% voting share comes from the A shares' 100 votes. The Novo Nordisk Foundation's interest is the same holding (it owns Novo Holdings 100%), so it is not listed separately. The 20-F lists no other holder above 5% of any class. DIVIDENDS: DKK 44,140 million (interim dividends paid during the year DKK 15,583 million plus dividends paid for the prior year DKK 28,557 million, per the statement of changes in equity), paid to all shareholders including Novo Holdings; Novo Nordisk has no material non-controlling interests. BUYBACKS: DKK 20,181 million purchase of treasury shares: the rest of the 2023 programme (DKK 1.6 billion) and the DKK 20 billion 2024 B-share programme, which ended 3 February 2025. STOCK COMP: DKK 2,289 million total share-based payment expense (note 5.1). GEOGRAPHY: the four reported areas. North America Operations includes the US (DKK 167,402 million); International Operations (DKK 112,231 million) is EMEA plus Region China plus Rest of World, so it is not repeated.

footprint.notes: Employees by area and income taxes paid come from the Annual Report 2024 (company-hosted PDF; it is Exhibit 15.1 to and incorporated by reference in the Form 20-F, hence tier 'filing'). The area split is headcount excluding Catalent (74,156); the group total including Catalent is 77,349, and Catalent's 3,193 employees are not allocated to areas. Only Denmark is a single country; EMEA ex-Denmark and Rest of World are Novo groupings with no country list, while North America and Region China are defined in the report itself. Taxes are split only into Denmark and outside Denmark (current-year taxes paid; DKK million). Sites are the 20-F Item 4.D table of major production facilities (production area in square meters) plus the headquarters sentence; API production in New Hampshire is mentioned in the 20-F text but not in the table. No U.S. state figures appear in the 20-F or Annual Report 2024, and a web search found no company-published U.S. state impact report (only project announcements such as the Clayton, NC expansion). Novo's FY2024 20-F says employees outside Denmark were 54% of the total.
